label_notes.Affiliative humor: Relationship-building humor, shared amusement, warmth, or bonding with audiences.
label_notes.Self-enhancing humor: Positive self-presentation, optimistic framing, or playful brand confidence.
label_notes.Aggressive humor: Teasing, ridicule, sarcasm targeted at others, competitive attacks, or superiority claims.
label_notes.Self-defeating humor: Self-deprecation, self-mockery, or intentionally lowering the brand's own status for comic effect.
label_notes.Non-humorous brand message: Plain promotional, informational, support, announcement, or conversational content without a clear humor strategy.
